integrity: Direct fiber derivation, analytic optimization, supplementary reproducible symbolic and numerical checks; no independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Rectangular lattices with time-frequency product exactly 2/3, normalized one-sided exponential window; no other rational densities, general windows, or noise stability proved. Historical priority is subject to comparison with specialized derivations of general rational Zak formulas.
title: Sharp noninteger-density Gabor conditioning for the one-sided exponential
